patches.new_text: "description": "命中时有 10% 几率使敌人回响 250ms。造成回响后，附近敌人会受到该次命中伤害 140% 的伤害。回响造成的伤害可以再次造成回响。受回响影响的敌人无法被再次施加回响。"
patches.source_text: Hits have a 10% chance to inflict Echoing for 250ms. Inflicting Echoing causes nearby Enemies to take 140% of the Hit Damage. Damage from Echoing can inflict Echoing. Echoing cannot be inflicted against Enemies affected by Echoing.
